question.text: Maximum leverage (exposure/NAV) permitted for a Cat III AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 124-125, Category III AIF leverage shall not exceed 2 times the NAV, with the leverage ratio calculated at the scheme level. Monitoring and reporting requirements support this cap. The Trap: 1x and 1.5x understate the regulatory ceiling, while 3x exceeds the source-prescribed cap. Note: Hold to the source rule: leverage capped at 2 times NAV, computed at the scheme level.
